title: ReplicaSet and Deployment: the controller that keeps the replica count

videos.script: Lesson 2 showed one command making five objects. This lesson is about the two in the middle. {{middle}} A ReplicaSet has one job. It counts the pods that carry its labels, and makes or removes pods until the count is right. {{count}} You will delete a pod and watch it come back. Then you will take a pod's label away, which is stranger: the pod keeps running, and the ReplicaSet makes a new one anyway. {{label}} A Deployment sits one level up. It never touches pods. It manages ReplicaSets, one per version of the template. {{versions}} That is how an update becomes possible at all. And it is why you will almost never create a ReplicaSet yourself. {{never}}
